implementation_progress.summary: Added typed EvidenceLink contract fields support_status, evidence_span, and citation_candidate; evidence_link schema and local backend preserve legacy calls while accepting the new contract.
Post-search Pilot-5 P03 records typed evidence-link replay output and scores typed_contract_coverage alongside support-label accuracy and span match.
Write-stage gates block active evidence_links or evidence_pack artifacts containing support_status=unsupported or support_status=contradicts.

Failed citation checks persist replayable citation_verification, review_issue, and gate_decision objects for unsupported/contradictory evidence links, hallucinated citation rows, and cross-topic draft references; Post-search Pilot-5 P03 scores citation_governance_replay_coverage and a deterministic PDF demo was generated at .tmp/rfb-opt-p0-002-demo/rfb-opt-p0-002-citation-governance.pdf.

category_definitions.claim_extraction: Scoped claim extraction without overclaiming or paper identity loss.
category_definitions.evidence_linking: Claim-to-span-to-citation support records, including partial or negative support.
category_definitions.citation_integrity: Citation candidate generation, identifier validation, support status, and hallucination prevention.
category_definitions.gap_detection: Real-gap detection, false-novelty blocking, and negative-evidence preservation.
category_definitions.baseline_identification: Strong baseline coverage, family boundaries, and stale-baseline invalidation.
category_definitions.section_drafting: Draft sections that preserve evidence, citation, stale-data, and scope boundaries.
category_definitions.pdf_final_bundle: Final bundle or PDF-facing citation integrity checks before export.
category_definitions.governance: Gate, rollback, abstention, cross-topic guard, and artifact trace policy evidence.
category_definitions.retrieval_health_check: Search, reranking, set completion, dedupe, deep anchor selection, and retrieval trace capture monitored as dependencies.

backlog_items.title: Preserve evidence links from claim to citation to span
backlog_items.finding: Downstream tasks require scoped claim, exact evidence_span, and support-aware citation_link objects.
backlog_items.optimization_target: Add a typed evidence-link contract that records claim scope, supporting span, contradiction or partial-support status, and the citation candidate that justifies the link.
backlog_items.approval_gate: Replay on current draft_dev tasks first; do not promote without held-out or promotion-test examples.

backlog_items.title: Block hallucinated or unsupported citations before drafting
backlog_items.finding: Citation-heavy tasks require identifier validation, support status, cross-topic guards, and block/rollback evidence before unsupported claims reach drafts.
backlog_items.optimization_target: Make citation verification statuses first-class replay objects and require failed citation checks to create review_issue and gate_decision records.
backlog_items.approval_gate: Citation changes must keep gold and judge bundles hidden and must not add external search to the v0 synthetic pack.

backlog_items.title: Calibrate gap, baseline, and direction quality
backlog_items.finding: The weaker downstream behavior is deciding whether prior work already closes a claimed gap and whether a proposed direction remains defensible.
backlog_items.optimization_target: Score baseline family coverage, stale-baseline invalidation, false-novelty detection, and direction ranking from explicit evidence.
backlog_items.approval_gate: Do not tune proposal prompts from retrieval-only scores; require downstream score reports first.

backlog_items.title: Add section-draft safeguards for stale or overreaching evidence
backlog_items.finding: Section-producing tasks expect the system to avoid stale propagation, claim scope overreach, and final citation drift before bundle assembly.
backlog_items.optimization_target: Make section_draft output carry evidence-link IDs, citation verification state, and rollback/block decisions when support is partial or stale.

backlog_items.title: Add final-bundle citation integrity replay checks
backlog_items.finding: Pilot-20 distinguishes final-bundle failures from upstream citation and section-drafting failures.
backlog_items.optimization_target: Add a final-bundle replay check that verifies every final citation resolves to a visible evidence link and no stale or hallucinated identifiers survive export.
backlog_items.approval_gate: Do not change public dataset readiness or release labels without human approval.

backlog_items.title: Turn gate, rollback, and abstention behavior into policy evidence
backlog_items.finding: Several failures require the correct behavior to abstain, block, rollback, or mark cross-topic provenance invalid, not simply produce an answer.
backlog_items.optimization_target: Ensure orchestrator gates emit gate_decision, rollback_event, review_issue, and artifact_ref objects with reason codes tied to RH axes.

backlog_items.title: Keep retrieval and provenance as downstream health checks
backlog_items.finding: Retrieval and deep-reading remain important dependencies, but operator feedback says they are not the main quality bottleneck.
backlog_items.optimization_target: Monitor these axes for regressions while prioritizing downstream semantic quality.

backlog_items.title: Separate infrastructure floor failures from semantic model failures
backlog_items.finding: The current baseline is a deliberate visible-contract floor, so it proves archive wiring and axis attribution but not model behavior.
backlog_items.optimization_target: Keep stub_zero as the reproducible floor and add human-approved model baselines for comparison.

backlog_items.title: Add archive queries for axis and category regressions
backlog_items.finding: Score reports can be archived, but operators still need a direct way to ask which RH axis and optimization category regressed across replay runs.
backlog_items.optimization_target: Expose an archive summary that groups researchflowbench_score_report records by benchmark, split, RH axis, backlog category, task, and candidate id.

primary_focus: section drafting, final-bundle integrity, and self-evolution decisions
